## Checklist (the reviewer checks it all again)

- [ ] its code is in `modules/<id>/` (readable `main.js`, not minified) — that's what makes it *verified*
- [ ] `README.md` says what it does, its commands, what it connects to (if anything)
- [ ] it asks only for the permissions it needs (and the README says why)
- [ ] no hidden network calls, no obfuscation, nothing beyond what the README says
- [ ] legal: no piracy, no scraping against a site's terms, third-party content credited with its license
- [ ] `version` raised in `plugin.json` (for an update)
- [ ] `node scripts/check-index.mjs` passes
- [ ] I tried it in ICEBREAKER (`plugin install` from my fork, then `plugin enable`)

Written with an AI? Fine — say so, and confirm you read and tested it.
